== Strategy ==

The biggest strategy in it is that you can get prety much whatever you need. Kal fas gets weapons, Get to your ships pulls starships and pilots, Rycar Ryjerd can pull lightsaber proficiency,Reflection, weapon of a fallen mentor, and mercenary armors, and it puts effects and devices back in the deck, and Yoda can get a sense when you need it.

All my urchins is great because since my objective limits my ability to innitiate battle, it lets me punish my oponent for innitiating a battle

Artoo Deeto in red 5 not only does it have the best destiny ever, if you use it as a starfighter, its a power7 manuver 6 hyperspeed 7 immune to below 5 and a destiny

Insurrection and Aim high prevents any movement to Nabboo, because both sites are interior, and cancels the free stormtrooper garison + Elis Herlot strategy

Mercenary Armor on Leia its a free +3 power, on lando it makes him 9 with armor 4 and immunity below 3, and it makes wedge a power 6 immune below 3 a pretty good ground fighter

Our most desperate hour hard to pull off, but normally it gives me around 8 back

Weapon of a fallen Mentor besides just recycling lightsabers, it also lets you put lightsabers on yoda and mace

I'd appreciate any suggestions
